statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion events
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is medically necessary to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the cardiac cause of transient neurological symptoms
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
